entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Treaty_Ceremony_Intro
entries.dialogueText: The Grand Throne Room of Palas Rezna had been arranged for the formal ratification of the Treaty of Zille. Foreign ambassadors from Konstantium, military commanders, and provincial nobles stood beneath portraits of Rizian kings before the parchment instrument and the royal seal of House Toras.

entries.speaker: Hugo Toras
entries.title: Hugo_Treaty_Declaration
entries.dialogueText: Your Majesty... The guns have fallen silent across the peninsula. The scribes await your royal seal to close this war in the annals of Rizia.
entries.conditions: Variable["RiziaDLC.Hugo_Arrested"] ~= true and Variable["RiziaDLC.Hugo_Executed"] ~= true and Variable["RiziaDLC.Hugo_Resigned"] ~= true

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Outcome_Hub_Prompt
entries.dialogueText: You stepped forward to the marble table to affix the Great Seal of Rizia.

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Sign_Decisive_Victory
entries.dialogueText: In the presence of Saint Wruhec and the noble estates of Rizia, I affix the royal seal. Zille is liberated and reunited with our kingdom!
entries.menuText: "Sign the Treaty of Restoration: Zille returns to the Crown of Rizia!"
entries.conditions: ((Variable["Zille_War_Outcome"] or 0) == 4 and Variable["Zille_Reparations_Won"] ~= true) or (Variable["Zille_War_Outcome"] or 0) == 0

entries.speaker: Hugo Toras
entries.title: Ack_Decisive_Ceremony
entries.dialogueText: The throne room erupted into thunderous cheers, bells pealing from every sanctuary in Porte Drazon. Hugo wiped tears of joy from his eyes, bowing deeply before his King. "Nearly thirty years of grief washed away in triumph! Long live King Romus the Restorer!"
entries.conditions: Variable["RiziaDLC.Hugo_Arrested"] ~= true and Variable["RiziaDLC.Hugo_Executed"] ~= true and Variable["RiziaDLC.Hugo_Resigned"] ~= true

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Sign_Victory_Reparations
entries.dialogueText: By our military and diplomatic leverage, Zille returns home AND Wraclawitz delivers gold and energy indemnities to rebuild every ruined harbor and silo in Brenas!
entries.menuText: "Sign the Treaty of Restoration & Indemnity: Zille returns and Wehlen pays reconstruction tribute!"

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Sign_Overwhelming_Triumph
entries.dialogueText: By this treaty, Wehlen surrenders Zille unconditionally, pays immense war indemnities, demilitarizes its southern shore, and recognizes the Free City of Grodzizg. House Toras stands supreme!
entries.menuText: "Sign the Treaty of Total Reparations: Wehlen humbled and Grodzizg placed under protection!"
entries.userScript: Variable["RiziaDLC.ZilleReturn_Success"] = true; Variable["RiziaDLC.Zille_PromisedToHouseToras"] = true; Variable["RiziaDLC.MapLayer_Zille_Brenas"] = true; Variable["Grodzizg_FreeCity"] = true;

entries.speaker: Lucita Azaro
entries.title: Ack_Overwhelming_Ceremony
entries.dialogueText: Lucita unsheathed her ceremonial saber and saluted with shining eyes. "An epochal triumph, Your Majesty! We have broken Wehlen's military power across the Gulf for a generation!"

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Sign_Independent_Buffer
entries.dialogueText: To spare our people further carnage, I sign the charter establishing the Independent Neutral State of Zille. May this neutral territory stand as a peaceful bridge rather than a battlefield.
entries.menuText: "Sign the Treaty of Neutrality: The Independent Republic of Zille is established."
entries.conditions: ((Variable["Zille_War_Outcome"] or 0) == 3 or Variable["Zille_Independent_Buffer"] == true or (Variable["Zille_War_Outcome"] or 0) == 0)

entries.speaker: Laurento Esquibel
entries.title: Ack_Buffer_Ceremony
entries.dialogueText: Laurento bowed solemnly. "The Alliance of Nations applauds your royal restraint, Your Majesty. Peace and guaranteed transit across the Strait of Kreleck are secured."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Sign_Tactical_Defeat
entries.dialogueText: With a heavy heart, I sign this armistice. Our soldiers fought with valor, yet Brenas must endure while we rebuild our strength. Zille remains outside our grasp... for now.
entries.menuText: "Sign the Armed Armistice: Hold the Brenas frontier under a bitter truce."

entries.speaker: Hugo Toras
entries.title: Ack_Tactical_Defeat
entries.dialogueText: A somber silence fell over the throne room. Hugo sighed deeply, his shoulders bowed. "A bitter day for House Toras, Romus—yet Brenas survives, and the realm endures."
entries.conditions: Variable["RiziaDLC.Hugo_Arrested"] ~= true and Variable["RiziaDLC.Hugo_Executed"] ~= true and Variable["RiziaDLC.Hugo_Resigned"] ~= true

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Sign_Total_Fiasco
entries.dialogueText: To prevent the destruction of Porte Drazon, I sign this humiliating peace. May God forgive me for the tragedy that has befallen our kingdom.
entries.menuText: "Sign the Instrument of Surrender: Concede southern Brenas to save Porte Drazon."
entries.userScript: Variable["RiziaDLC.ZilleReturn_Success"] = false; Variable["Brenas_Lost_To_Wehlen"] = true; Variable["RiziaDLC.Azaro_HasPowerToCoup"] = true;

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Ack_Total_Fiasco
entries.dialogueText: Shouts of outrage broke out among the assembled officers. Duke Taddeus stormed from the hall in disgust while dark whispers of a military coup echoed through the stone corridors.

entries.speaker: Laurento Esquibel
entries.title: Laurento_Treaty_Declaration
entries.dialogueText: Your Majesty. The diplomatic instrument lies before you, witnessed by foreign envoys from Konstantium. The realm awaits your royal signature.
entries.conditions: (Variable["RiziaDLC.Hugo_Arrested"] == true or Variable["RiziaDLC.Hugo_Executed"] == true or Variable["RiziaDLC.Hugo_Resigned"] == true)

entries.speaker: Laurento Esquibel
entries.title: Ack_Decisive_NoHugo
entries.dialogueText: Thunderous applause shook the marble pillars as cathedral bells rang across Porte Drazon. Laurento bowed deeply. "A historic restoration, Your Majesty. Zille is home."
entries.conditions: (Variable["RiziaDLC.Hugo_Arrested"] == true or Variable["RiziaDLC.Hugo_Executed"] == true or Variable["RiziaDLC.Hugo_Resigned"] == true)

entries.speaker: Carlos Robles Azaro
entries.title: Ack_Overwhelming_NoLucita
entries.dialogueText: General Carlos Azaro raised his saber in crisp salute. "An epochal victory, Your Majesty. Rizia stands unchallenged across the Gulf of Moridia."

entries.speaker: Laurento Esquibel
entries.title: Ack_Tactical_Defeat_NoHugo
entries.dialogueText: A heavy hush fell over the chamber. Laurento lowered his eyes solemnly. "A bitter hour, Your Majesty, yet the kingdom remains intact to rise another day."
entries.conditions: (Variable["RiziaDLC.Hugo_Arrested"] == true or Variable["RiziaDLC.Hugo_Executed"] == true or Variable["RiziaDLC.Hugo_Resigned"] == true)

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Ack_Total_Fiasco_NoTaddeus
entries.dialogueText: Shouts of outrage erupted among the assembled noble houses and generals. Officers slammed their sabers onto the marble floor, and whispers of mutiny filled Palas Rezna.

entries.speaker: Laurento Esquibel
entries.title: Treaty_AN_HighLegitimacy
entries.dialogueText: "Thanks to our strict adherence to the lapsed 1927 agreement and civilized conduct, even neutral delegates in Kyrute acknowledge Rizia acted with restraint."

entries.speaker: Laurento Esquibel
entries.title: Treaty_AN_PalesShadow
entries.dialogueText: "While our Zille casualty ledger stands distinct, fighting concurrently against Pales has stretched foreign sympathy thin—we must ratify cleanly and stabilize the realm."
entries.conditions: not ((Variable["Zille_AN_Legitimacy"] or 0) >= 3) and (((Variable["Zille_Pales_TotalPlayerDead"] or 0) > 0 or Variable["RiziaDLC.Pales_War"] == true or Variable["RiziaDLC.Diplomacy_Pales_DeclareWar"] == true or Variable["RiziaDLC.CountryRelation_Pales_AtWar"] == true))

entries.speaker: Laurento Esquibel
entries.title: Treaty_AN_Standard
entries.dialogueText: "Both superpowers are closely observing the exact clauses inscribed on this parchment today, Your Majesty."
entries.conditions: not ((Variable["Zille_AN_Legitimacy"] or 0) >= 3) and (((Variable["Zille_Pales_TotalPlayerDead"] or 0) <= 0 and Variable["RiziaDLC.Pales_War"] ~= true and Variable["RiziaDLC.Diplomacy_Pales_DeclareWar"] ~= true and Variable["RiziaDLC.CountryRelation_Pales_AtWar"] ~= true))
